candidates.review_note: All unfinished dwarves move equally; each distinct positive initial distance is one stopping event. A candy to the left can never be reached.
A starting character with no smaller predecessor admits no lexicographically decreasing extension. Otherwise Ann extends to the first prefix-minimum occurrence, leaving a losing state.

For each candidate period, build allowed source/cipher column matches from all observed block positions, solve a perfect matching, then invert that mapping. Use the smallest feasible period and pad unknown final positions.

Exact squared segment-circle tests decide visibility; by time T each caster has floor(T/delay)+1 shots including time zero. Capacitated bipartite flow and monotone binary search find minimum completion time.
Normalize ray directions exactly by gcd, sort by half-plane and integer cross product, and compare clockwise/counterclockwise inclusive arc counts; endpoint multiplicities belong to both arcs.
